request: When a suite run reaches its timeout, every process that run started must end, and the run must return even if a child still holds the output pipe open.

defects.description: Own-history fix 5d202a901b (2026-10-14): fix(bench): kill a timed-out suite's whole process tree

trigger.input:
printf %s  | base64 -d > internal/bench/proc_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run \^TestRunSuiteTimeoutKillsTheWholeProcessTree\$\|\^TestPerTestTimeoutKillsTheWholeProcessTree\$\|\^TestRunSuiteStillReportsAFinishedSuite\$ ./internal/bench >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
